title: Demo call 2: rescheduling, with the caller interrupting Callie

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Thanks for calling Bright Side Dental. I'm Callie, the clinic's AI assistant, and this call may be recorded. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Hi, it's Sophie, or Rossi. I have a cleaning tomorrow afternoon and I need to move it.

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Let me look up your appointment. Sophie, one moment please. I found your cleaning and checkup on Wednesday, October 7th at 8am. What day and time would you like instead?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Do you have anything on Thursday?

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Let me check. I have Thursday, October 8, at 9.30 a.m., 10 a.m. or 10 a.m.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Sorry, sorry, in the morning, please.

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Sure, one second. No problem. I have Thursday morning at 9 30 a.m. 10 a.m. Or 10 30 a.m. Which one works for you?

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Just to confirm, I'll move your cleaning and check up from Wednesday, October 7th at 8 a.m. to Thursday, October 8th at 9, 30 a.m. Is that right?

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Done. Your cleaning and check-up is now on Thursday, October 8th at 9, 30 a.m. I've texted you the new time. Anything else?

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Thanks for calling Bright Side Dental. Have a great day. Goodbye.
